remarks: Located in the Hunt Club area of Westport, this Modern Farmhouse Colonial rental offers flexible living space across four finished levels. The home features a covered Brazilian mahogany front porch, open floor plan, 10' ceilings on the first floor, 9' ceilings on the second floor, Metro trim detail, crown moldings, and wainscoting throughout.  The kitchen opens directly to the great room and receives strong natural light through oversized sliding doors. The main level also includes a formal dining room and private library/home office.  The primary suite includes a fireplace, tray ceiling, two closets, and updated marble bath with soaking tub and separate shower. One secondary bedroom includes an en-suite bath, while two additional bedrooms share a full bath. The third floor includes an additional bedroom, full bath, and flexible recreation/play space.  The finished lower level includes a media room, gym area, office space, and full bath, offering additional work and living flexibility.  Large front and rear lawns provide usable outdoor space with room for entertaining, recreation, or play. Convenient access to Westport amenities, train, shopping, beaches, schools, and commuting routes.  Available for annual or multi-year lease.
